# Principal Components Analysis (PCA) and reliability analysis  {#sec-t9}


## Learning outcomes {#sec-t9ILO}

After viewing the tutorial materials and following along with the demonstration, you can:

1. Set-up, run and interpret PCA and reliability analysis 

## Datasets {#sec-t9data}

The moderation demonstration uses the dataset [**field2017_SAQ**](data/field2017_SAQ.jasp) which was prepared by Andy Field and included in Field [-@field2017]. The (fictional) dataset contains responses to questions about various aspects of statistics anxiety.
